whatThisIs: [Facilitated support group for individuals dealing with pregnancy loss, infant loss, fertility challenges, and parenting after loss. They are free 90 minute sessions, offered over Zoom and facilitated by trained peer supporters offering confidentiality to participants.]
whoItHelps: Individuals struggling with the above topics looking for online support groups
All support groups are offered for free and accessible to anyone with a device that can run zoom with camera functionality
whatToKnow: Each Support group has a limited number participants and is admitted on a first-come, first-served basis”,”There are currently 55 available support groups all with different topics and goals”,” For the safety of all group members cameras are required during introductions”,”For Confidentiality student and or Clinical observations are not allowed in group spaces
